title: Vision Termination Credits on Premium Billing Accounts: Monthly Amount by Billing Method
content:
**Rule.** For the termination credit of a vision plan unit on a Premium Billing Accounts arrangement, the amount per month credited depends on how the unit's months were billed. The tiers are read in this order, and the first that holds decides:

1. **Billed on AutoPay.** The months were billed on AutoPay when the account's arrangement either carries an AutoPay discount (of the seven arrangements, only Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly, at 1.00 a month), or does not accept bank draft (EFT) and the account nevertheless collected regular automatic bank drafts within twelve months before the credit date — drafts only the AutoPay arrangement the account has since left could have collected. The amount per month is then the unit's filed monthly premium less a share of the AutoPay arrangement's monthly discount of 1.00, that share being 1.00 divided equally among the plan units the account bills. The plan units are counted as two for the account's dental and vision plans, plus one for each active orthodontic rider in Orthodontic Benefit Riders that the account funds.
2. **Billed at the prepay discount.** When the arrangement carries a prepay discount (only Cascade Individual Annual Prepay, at 4 percent) and has issued a twelve-month invoice within twelve months before the credit date, the amount per month is the unit's filed monthly premium reduced by the prepay discount percentage.
3. **Otherwise** the amount per month is the unit's filed monthly premium.

The filed monthly premium is the monthly premium of the unit's Vision Plans plan for its coverage tier. A record counts as falling within a number of months before the credit date when the whole calendar months from its date to the credit date, counted the way an anniversary is counted (a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it), are fewer than that number. The amount per month is carried unrounded into the credit.

**Condition table.**
| AutoPay discount on the arrangement | Arrangement accepts EFT | Regular automatic drafts within twelve months | Prepay discount and twelve-month invoice within twelve months | Amount per month |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | — | — | — | filed premium less 1.00 shared among plan units |
| no | no | one or more | — | filed premium less 1.00 shared among plan units |
| no | no | none | yes | filed premium less 4 percent |
| no | yes | — | yes | filed premium less 4 percent |
| no | — | none, or EFT accepted | no | filed premium |

**Hypothetical illustrations.** Filed premium 13.25 on Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly with one active orthodontic rider: three plan units, a share of 1.00 divided by three, so the amount per month is 13.25 less 0.333…, about 12.9167 (unrounded). The same premium on Cascade Individual Annual Prepay that issued a twelve-month invoice five months ago: 13.25 less 4 percent, 12.72. On Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly (which does not accept EFT) with two regular automatic drafts collected eight months ago and two plan units: 13.25 less 0.50, 12.75.
